memory.description: Optional knowledge graph memory for approved examples, recurring patterns, and brand-gate decisions.

fetch.description: Optional public web extraction helper. Use only for allowed public pages.

ghost-browser.description: Optional public social and JavaScript-heavy page helper. Uses local Chrome/Chromium when available. Do not bypass logins, paywalls, captchas, robots.txt, rate limits, or platform restrictions.

youtube-transcript.description: Optional transcript helper. The Python package remains the primary transcript path.

sequential-thinking.description: Structured step-by-step reasoning for scoring, clip selection, and source validation.

args: set -a; source ./API_keys.env; set +a; exec npx -y mcp-remote@latest "https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp?exaApiKey=${EXA_API_KEY}"
exa.description: Semantic search for trend discovery and source hunting. Loads EXA_API_KEY from API_keys.env.

args: set -a; source ./API_keys.env; set +a; exec npx -y tavily-mcp@latest
tavily.description: AI-optimized web search fallback. Loads TAVILY_API_KEY from API_keys.env.

args: set -a; source ./API_keys.env; set +a; exec npx -y firecrawl-mcp@latest
firecrawl.description: Public web extraction to clean markdown. Loads FIRECRAWL_API_KEY from API_keys.env.

args: set -a; source ./API_keys.env; set +a; exec npx -y mcp-remote@latest https://scrapegraph-mcp.onrender.com/mcp --header "X-API-Key:${SCRAPEGRAPH_API_KEY}"
scrapegraph.description: AI-powered structured extraction from URLs. Loads SCRAPEGRAPH_API_KEY from API_keys.env.

brave-search.description: Enable later after setting BRAVE_API_KEY locally. Useful for public discovery when fetch plus yt-dlp is not enough.

scrapling.description: Use only when normal public extraction fails on JavaScript-heavy pages. Do not bypass paywalls, captchas, login gates, robots.txt, rate limits, or platform restrictions.

gpt_researcher.description: Optional deep-research helper for Source Hunter. Use as a sub-agent only; do not replace Goblin Recon scoring or brand gate.

trendradar.description: Optional reference/input source for Trend Radar. Adapt useful signals into Layer 1; do not replace the existing skill.

notion_or_sheets.description: Optional approved-content tracker. Enable only after workspace approval and secret setup.
